graphs.name: US B1/B2 Visa Process — Brazilian Professor, Short-Term Academic Visit
graphs.description: End-to-end B1/B2 application route for a Brazilian professor invited to the United States for a short academic exchange (seminars, lectures, laboratory visits). Covers the 9-5-6 honorarium rule, the B1-versus-J1 boundary, the two available application venues (Brazil or Guangzhou, China), the document set, the interview, and post-approval steps through EVUS and entry.
